text:
Modern Windows Media Player is a free, open-source video and audio player for Windows 10 and Windows 11. Built around VLC playback technology and a clean Windows interface, it makes watching movies, listening to music, streaming network media, and managing playback simple — without requiring a command line.

 ⬇️ Installation

 Download the Windows application 

1. Open the repository's Releases page.
2. Download the latest release archive Modern Windows Media Player 4.4.5.zip .
3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice.
4. Keep Modern Windows Media Player 4.4.5.exe and libvlc.dll together in that folder.
5. Double-click Modern Windows Media Player 4.4.5.exe to launch the application.

 ✨ Features

Everything you need for a comfortable desktop media playback experience.

- 🎬 Universal Video Playback — Play a wide variety of video formats using the powerful VLC-based media engine.
- 🎵 Audio File Support — Enjoy music and audio files with convenient playback controls and an intuitive interface.
- 🪟 Modern Windows Interface — Experience a clean, Fluent-inspired desktop design with layouts adapted to different screen sizes.
- 📺 Picture-in-Picture Mode — Keep videos visible in a compact floating player while working in other applications.
- 🌐 Network Media Streaming — Browse supported network locations and play media stored on other devices.
- 📡 Chromecast Support — Send compatible media to supported Chromecast devices for playback on a larger screen.
- ⌨️ Keyboard Shortcuts — Control playback, volume, seeking, and window size using convenient keyboard commands.
- 👆 Touch and Gesture Controls — Navigate playback and adjust volume using intuitive touch-friendly interactions.
- 📸 Video Frame Capture — Save individual video frames as image files directly from the player.
- 📐 Flexible Window Sizing — Adjust the playback window quickly with dedicated keyboard shortcuts.
- 🎞️ Subtitle Support — Enjoy supported subtitle tracks and a more accessible viewing experience.
- ⚡ Hardware-Accelerated Playback — Benefit from supported video acceleration capabilities offered by the underlying playback platform.

 🖼️ Overview

A desktop media experience designed to keep playback controls accessible without getting in the way of your content.

 

 A player for everyday media

Whether you are watching downloaded movies, browsing personal video collections, listening to music, or accessing media over a local network, the application provides a unified playback experience.

 Designed for Windows

- Familiar desktop interaction patterns.
- Responsive layouts for different window sizes.
- Touch-friendly controls for compatible devices.
- Convenient keyboard navigation.
- A focused playback interface with minimal distractions.

 🚀 Usage

Getting started is straightforward:

1. Open the application from your Windows desktop or Start menu.
2. Choose your media by opening a supported video or audio file.
3. Control playback using the on-screen controls or keyboard shortcuts.
4. Adjust your viewing experience with window resizing and picture-in-picture.
5. Explore additional playback options such as subtitles, network media, and supported casting devices.

 ⌨️ Keyboard shortcuts

Keyboard controls make everyday media playback faster and easier.

 Action Control 
 --- --- 
 Play / Pause Space 
 Seek through media Arrow keys 
 Adjust volume Volume controls 
 Change window size Number keys 1–4 
 Toggle playback options Supported shortcut keys 

 Available shortcuts may depend on the active playback view and application version. 

 🖥️ Supported Platforms

 Platform Support 
 --- --- 
 Windows 10 Supported on compatible builds 
 Windows 11 Supported 
 Touch-enabled Windows devices Supported 
 Xbox Platform-dependent compatibility 

The application uses the Universal Windows Platform (UWP) and a VLC-powered playback stack.

 🎥 Media Playback Technology

The player uses the VLC ecosystem through LibVLCSharp, bringing established media playback capabilities into a native-feeling Windows application.

Key technology components:

- C and .NET — Application development and core functionality.
- Universal Windows Platform (UWP) — Windows application framework.
- LibVLCSharp — .NET bindings for VLC media playback.
- libVLC — Underlying multimedia playback engine.
- Fluent-inspired UI — Consistent Windows-oriented interaction and visual design.

This architecture provides a foundation for flexible media playback without requiring users to configure a separate command-line media tool.

 🌐 Network and Streaming Features

Your media library does not have to live exclusively on your PC.

Supported network playback workflows can make it easier to:

- Access media from compatible network locations.
- Browse available remote media sources.
- Play supported files stored on other devices.
- Cast compatible content to Chromecast devices.
- Enjoy personal media collections across your home network.

Network playback depends on source compatibility, device availability, and network configuration.

 🎞️ Supported Media and Compatibility

Playback compatibility is provided by the integrated VLC media engine.

Depending on the installed playback components and media configuration, the player can handle many common multimedia formats and containers.

 Media type Examples 
 --- --- 
 Video containers MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV 
 Video codecs H.264, H.265, VP9 
 Audio containers MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC 
 Streaming media Compatible network streams 
 Subtitles Supported embedded and external subtitle tracks 

 Actual format and codec support depends on the playback engine, platform capabilities, and media configuration. This table is illustrative rather than a guarantee that every codec is supported on every device. 

 🔒 Security and Privacy

Your desktop media player should respect your privacy.

- No telemetry or tracking: The application is designed without built-in user activity tracking.
